description: For all propositional formulas \(A\) and \(B\), the premises \(A\) and \(A\to B\) entail \(B\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.modusPonens_entails.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (A B : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula α) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Entails {A, A.impl B} B
